mapper.select: select session_id, user_id, user_name, agent_id, agent_name, status, last_message, last_message_time, create_time, update_time from mall_chat_session where session_id = #{sessionId}

select session_id, user_id, user_name, agent_id, agent_name, status, last_message, last_message_time, create_time, update_time from mall_chat_session where user_id = #{userId} and status != '3' order by session_id desc limit 1
select session_id, user_id, user_name, agent_id, agent_name, status, last_message, last_message_time, create_time, update_time from mall_chat_session where status = '1' order by create_time asc
mapper.insert: insert into mall_chat_session (user_id, user_name, agent_id, agent_name, status, last_message, last_message_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{agentId}, #{agentName}, #{status}, #{lastMessage}, #{lastMessageTime}, sysdate(), sysdate())
